description: Check if your text is an isogram — no letter repeated — with duplicate letters listed.

faqs.a: An isogram is a word or phrase with no repeating letters, like 'subdermatoglyphic'. Case and spaces are ignored.
Each repeated letter is listed with how many times it appears.
faqs.q: What does it show if it fails?

faqs.a: Yes — only the letters A-Z are checked, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.

howto: See the verdict and any duplicate letters.
title: Isogram Checker
